Trisara Phuket

All-pool-villa luxury on a private northwest coast bay

Phuket/Hotel/Trisara Phuket

About

Trisara is Phuket's most exclusive all-villa resort, tucked into a private bay on the island's quiet northwest coast. Every villa has its own infinity pool, and the resort is famed for Michelin-listed restaurant PRU and flawless private service.

Trisara 是普吉最顶级的全别墅度假村，隐匿于岛上安静的西北海岸私密海湾。每栋别墅均配私人无边泳池，米其林入选餐厅 PRU 与无微不至的私人服务闻名遐迩。
